title: [PRH] Project Rabbit Hutch
description: Project Rabbit Hutch is a my personal modpack, designed around adding some polish to Minecraft without the use of shaders.
body:
# **Project Rabbit Hutch**

Project Rabbit Hutch is a designed to be fast and compact, this is my personal modpack I use, and the idea was to use no shaders to get he best performance I can, while improving the visuals of Minecraft.
This modpack is designed to be client side, so should be fully compatable with most if not all multiplayer servers.
